'''''Sempervivium calcareum''''', the '''houseleek''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the stonecrop [[family (botany)|family]] Crassulaceae, [[native species|native]] to the southern Alps in Europe. An [[evergreen]] [[succulent plant|succulent]] [[perennial plant|perennial]], it has a [[rosette (botany)|rosette]] with thick leaves that store water. The leaves are usually green with reddish-purple tips. This plant reproduces with [[asexual reproduction|asexual]] budding and [[monocarpic]] sexual reproduction.<ref>{{cite web 
| url = https://worldofsucculents.com/sempervivum-calcareum-houseleek | title = Sempervivum calcareum 
| date = 21 June 2016 
| publisher = World of Succulents | accessdate = 9 November 2018}}</ref> 

''Sempervivum calcareum'' is cultivated as an ornamental garden plant. It is suitable for a well-drained spot in full sun, such as a [[rockery]]. The [[cultivars]] 'Extra',<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/135229/i-Sempervivum-calcareum-i-Extra/Details | title = RHS Plantfinder - ''Sempervivum calcareum'' 'Extra' | accessdate = 9 November 2018}}</ref> 'Guillaumes'<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/281606/i-Sempervivum-calcareum-i-Guillaumes/Details | title = RHS Plantfinder - ''Sempervivum calcareum'' 'Guillaumes' | accessdate = 9 November 2018}}</ref> and 'Sir William Lawrence'<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/47612/Sempervivum-calcareum-Sir-William-Lawrence/Details | title = ''Sempervivum calcareum'' 'Sir William Lawrence' | publisher = RHS | access-date = 5 March 2021}}</ref> have gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = July 2017 | page = 96 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | accessdate = 9 November 2018}}</ref>
